svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.13.4.3 Rough-in for a Subfloor Depressurization System
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.13 DAMPPROOFING, WATERPROOFING AND SOIL GAS CONTROL
Rough-in for a Subfloor Depressurization System

g.text: Inlet at or near the centre of the
floor-on-ground, open to the gas-permeable layer
Air barrier system; pipe sealed to it,
The inlet below the floor, Sentences (1) and (3)
Labelled every 1.8 m (5′-10⅞″) and at every
Terminates outside, here not less than

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Floors-on-ground accommodate the future installation of a
subfloor depressurization system by installing a radon vent
pipe, and a contiguous gas-permeable layer between the air
barrier system and the ground consisting of
(a) a material or materials that allow effective depressurization
of that space (see Sentence 9.16.2.1.(1)), or (b) not less than 100
mm (3 15/16″) of coarse clean granular material containing not more
than 10% of material that would pass a 4 mm sieve.
The radon vent pipe is sealed to the air barrier system with
no perforations above it, has inlets for effective
depressurization and permits connection to depressurization
equipment
Where it passes through conditioned space it is completely
surrounded by conditioned space. Pipe and fittings are in
accordance with 7.1.3 of CAN/CGSB-149.11.
It terminates outside the building in a manner that does not
constitute a hazard, is installed to prevent the accumulation
of moisture and away from where snow and ice accumulate
And is clearly labelled every 1.8 m (5′-10⅞″) and at every change
in direction to indicate that it is intended only for the future
removal of radon from below the floor-on-ground.
Deemed to comply with Clause (2)(b): inlets below the air
barrier system at or near the centre of the floor-on-ground,
with gas-permeable material extending not less than 100 mm
beyond any inlet
Deemed to comply with Clause (2)(f): terminates outside not
less than 1.8 m from a property line, located in accordance
with 7.2.4.6 or 7.3.4 of CAN/CGSB-149.11
With the opening fitted with a corrosion-resistant screen or grille
with a mesh opening of 10 mm to 12.5 mm (⅜″ to ½″), or a product of
equivalent air flow performance.
Drawn: cut through the centre of the floor. Yellow bands: labels on the pipe. Route, exit point and opening detail are one example.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.13.4.3. (page 9-113)
